## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │

So the workflow expects a project with index.html or vite. Screenshots are captured automatically. I need to build a game.

Plan: Build a browser game with Three.js — a 3D arena fighter with dismemberment, blood particles, gibs, sword vs hammer, ragdoll-ish enemies. Since we can't rely on external assets (and the sandbox may have no internet in the browser), better to build everything with primitive geometry and procedural textures — no external assets. Use Three.js from npm and bundle with Vite? Vite is supported. But dependencies need installing; the runtime handles npm install automatically for vite projects. Let me check network availability for npm.

Actually, the "html" type is simplest: pure index.html + JS modules, no npm. But Three.js would need a CDN. If the preview environment blocks internet, CDN fails. Safer: use vite + three from npm. Let me test npm install works.

Let me check node/npm availability and network.

Also consider file:// vs served — served over http, so ES modules work.

The core ask: gory arena combat where you spawn with a sword or hammer, hammer crushes head/body/arms, sword cuts off limbs and cuts enemies in half. That's ambitious. I need to deliver a genuinely playable, good-looking game — first-person or third-person? First-person melee combat with a physics-driven dismemberment system is the most visceral and doable:

- First-person view with weapon in hand (sword or hammer), swing with mouse click, stamina/combos.
- Enemies (gladiators) approach with their own weapons, attack, can be blocked/parried.
- Damage model: body part hitboxes (head, torso, arms, legs) with a health/detach threshold. When a limb's damage exceeds threshold, detach it — spawn a severed limb rigid body with blood fountain; torso bisection for the sword on low torso health.
- Gore: blood particle system (instanced points or sprites), blood decals on ground (flat planes / decal meshes), gibs, blood spray.
- Corpse pieces fall with simple physics (custom, not full rigid body lib).
- Waves in an arena, score, health, round counter, weapon switching (spawn with chosen weapon — "you spawn with a sword or a hammer" suggests choosing at start).
- Mobile touch controls (required per AGENTS.md: support Android/iOS with touch). Add touch joystick + attack buttons and drag look.
- WebGL via Three.js. Performance: use instanced/low-poly procedural characters.
- Audio: WebAudio procedural sounds (whoosh, impact, gore squelch, scream) — no assets.
- UI: gritty arena HUD, title screen, weapon select, wave announcements, damage vignette, kill feed.

Rendering approach: a stylized low-poly gladiator built from segmented body parts (capsule/sphere/box geometries) so dismemberment is natural: each part is a mesh in a group. On sever, detach mesh to world with velocity + spin, add stump blood spray decal.

For "cut him in half": when torso takes heavy slash damage, split torso into upper/lower halves — model torso as two stacked segments; on bisect, both halves become separate ragdoll pieces with spine/entrails.

Physics: write a small custom rigid body sim for detached parts: gravity, ground collision with bounce, angular velocity, friction, rest. Good enough.

Enemy AI: state machine — approach, circle, telegraph windup, attack, stagger, block, death (ragdoll-ish collapse). Health per body part. Hit detection: sphere sweep of weapon blade vs part spheres during swing (sample the weapon tip and mid each frame over swing arc, check capsule-sphere distance). Or use raycast/spherecast along weapon path.

Camera: first person, head bob, weapon swing animation with easing, hit-stop (freeze frames on impact), screen shake, blood splatter on screen when close.

Controls: WASD, mouse look (pointer lock), left click attack, right click block/heavy? Shift dash/dodge, 1/2 to switch weapon between waves? Simple: block on right mouse, heavy attack on hold? Let's design:

- Left click: light attack (sword slash / hammer swing)
- Right click: block/parry (raise weapon)
- Shift: dodge/backstep
- Space: kick/shove? Maybe bash.
- F: execute finisher on staggered enemy (gory).
- Weapon select at start: sword or hammer. Maybe also allow R to swap mid-arena via pickups? Keep spawn selection at menu, and unlock both eventually. Let's allow switching with Q if a second weapon is on the ground? Overkill. Simpler: choose at menu; plus a mid-run pickup spawns after each wave letting you swap.

Scoring/combo multiplier, wave progression, boss wave maybe.

  softDropTexture

const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel)

    this.canvas = $('#scene')

    this.floaterCount = 0
    this.touch = matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches || 'ontouchstart' in window
    this.isMobile = matchMedia('(max-width: 760px)').matches
    this.paused = false
    this.timeScale = 1
    this.best = this.loadBest()
    this.menuAngle = 0.3
    this.crowdPulse = 0
    this.lastHeartbeat = 0
    this.lockRequested = false
    this.hadLock = false
    this.enemyId = 0
    this.stats = { dismemberments: 0, bestCombo: 0 }
    this._v = new THREE.Vector3()
    this._v2 = new THREE.Vector3()

    this.setupRenderer()
    this.setupScene()
    this.setupUI()
    this.loop = this.loop.bind(this)
    this.clock = new THREE.Clock()
    this.hideLoading()
    requestAnimationFrame(this.loop)
  }

  setupRenderer() {
    const gl = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl2') || document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl')
    let rendererName = ''
    try {
      const dbg = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info')
      rendererName = dbg ? gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) : ''
    } catch {}
    gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext()
    this.low = /swiftshader|llvmpipe|software|basic render/i.test(rendererName)
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas: this.canvas,
      antialias: !this.low,
      powerPreference: 'high-performance',
      alpha: false
    })
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, this.low ? 1 : 1.7))
    this.renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)
    this.renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
    this.renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping
    this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12
    if (!this.low) {
      this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true
      this.renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap
    }
    this.renderer.info.autoReset = true
    this.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', (e) => e.preventDefault())
  }

  setupScene() {
    this.scene = new THREE.Scene()
    this.scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x160a0b, this.low ? 0.02 : 0.016)
    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(78, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.05, 300)
    this.camera.position.set(0, 5.5, 15)
    this.scene.add(this.camera)

    this.arena = new Arena(this.scene, this.renderer, this.low)
    this.gore = new Gore(this.scene, this.renderer, this.low ? 'low' : 'high')
    this.player = new Player(this.camera, this.scene, this.gore, this)
    this.player.rig.visible = false
    this.player.setWeapon(this.selectedWeapon, true)

    this.ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x3b2a26, 0.35)
    this.scene.add(this.ambient)

    this.camera.position.set(15, 7, 13)
    this.camera.lookAt(0, 1.5, 0)
  }

  loadBest() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('bloodpit.best')
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw)
    } catch {}
    return { score: 0, wave: 0, kills: 0 }
  }

  saveBest() {
    try { localStorage.setItem('bloodpit.best', JSON.stringify(this.best)) } catch {}
  }

  hideLoading() {
    const el = $('#loading')
    setTimeout(() => {
      el.classList.remove('open')
      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 600)
    }, 260)
  }

  setupUI() {
    document.body.classList.toggle('touch', this.touch)
    this.ui = {
      menu: $('#menu'),
      hud: $('#hud'),
      pause: $('#pause'),
      gameover: $('#gameover'),
      healthFill: $('#health-fill'),
      healthLag: $('#health-lag'),
      waveNumber: $('#wave-number'),
      enemiesLeft: $('#enemies-left'),
      score: $('#score'),
      kills: $('#kills'),
      comboWrap: $('#combo-wrap'),
      comboMult: $('#combo-mult'),
      comboTimer: $('#combo-timer i'),
      weaponName: $('#weapon-name'),
      weaponKind: $('#weapon-kind'),
      weaponIcon: $('#weapon-icon'),
      bossWrap: $('#boss-wrap'),
      bossName: $('#boss-name'),
      bossFill: $('#boss-fill'),
      crosshair: $('#crosshair'),
      chargeRing: $('#charge-ring'),
      ringFill: $('#ring-fill'),
      hitmarker: $('#hitmarker'),
      banner: $('#banner'),
      bannerKicker: $('#banner-kicker'),
      bannerTitle: $('#banner-title'),
      bannerSub: $('#banner-sub'),
      killfeed: $('#killfeed'),
      floaters: $('#floaters'),
      interact: $('#interact-prompt'),
      interactText: $('#interact-prompt span'),
      exec: $('#exec-prompt'),
      damageFlash: $('#damage-flash'),
      touchControls: $('#touch-controls'),
      rotate: $('#rotate-note'),
      pauseBtn: $('#pause-btn'),
      bloodCanvas: $('#fx-blood')
    }
    this.bloodCtx = this.ui.bloodCanvas.getContext('2d')
    this.resizeBlood()
    this.ui.bestScore.textContent = this.best.score || 0
    this.ui.bestWave.textContent = this.best.wave ? roman(this.best.wave) : '—'
    this.bindUI()
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.onResize())
    this.onResize()
  }

  bindUI() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.weapon-card').forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.weapon-card').forEach((c) => {
          c.classList.toggle('selected', c === card)
          c.setAttribute('aria-checked', c === card ? 'true' : 'false')
        })
        this.selectedWeapon = card.dataset.weapon
        sound.init()
        sound.ui()
      })
    })
    $('#play-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startRun(this.selectedWeapon))
    $('#retry-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startRun(this.player.weaponId || this.selectedWeapon))
    $('#menu-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.toMenu())
    $('#resume-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resume())
    $('#quit-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.toMenu())
    $('#pause-btn').addEventListener('click', () => this.pause())
    $('#pause-btn').addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.stopPropagation())

    // keyboard
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => this.onKeyDown(e))
    window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => this.onKeyUp(e))
    window.addEventListener('blur', () => { this.keys = {}; this.player.blockUp() })

    // mouse / pointer
    this.canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault())
    this.canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => this.onMouseDown(e))
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => this.onMouseUp(e))
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => this.onMouseMove(e))
    this.canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false })

    // pointer lock
    document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
      const locked = document.pointerLockElement === this.canvas
      if (locked) this.hadLock = true
      if (!locked && this.hadLock && this.state === 'playing' && !this.touch) {
        this.hadLock = false
        this.pause()
      }
    })
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden && this.state === 'playing') this.pause()
    })

    this.setupTouch()
    this.keys = {}
    this.dragging = false
    this.dragMoved = 0
    this.lastMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 }
    this.setTouchVisible(false)
  }

  setupTouch() {
    const zone = $('#stick-zone')
    const knob = $('#stick-knob')
    let active = false
    let startX = 0, startY = 0
    const maxR = 46
    const updateStick = (x, y) => {
      let dx = x - startX, dy = y - startY
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
      if (d > maxR) { dx = dx / d * maxR; dy = dy / d * maxR }
      knob.style.transform = `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)`
      this.player.moveInput.x = clamp(dx / maxR, -1, 1)
      this.player.moveInput.z = clamp(dy / maxR, -1, 1)
    }
    zone.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      active = true
      zone.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
      const r = zone.getBoundingClientRect()
      startX = r.left + r.width / 2
      startY = r.top + r.height / 2
      updateStick(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    })
    zone.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!active) return
      e.preventDefault()
      updateStick(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    })
    const end = (e) => {
      if (!active) return
      active = false
      knob.style.transform = 'translate(0,0)'
      this.player.moveInput.x = 0
      this.player.moveInput.z = 0
    }
    zone.addEventListener('pointerup', end)
    zone.addEventListener('pointercancel', end)

    // look drag anywhere on the canvas
    let lookId = null
    let lx = 0, ly = 0
    this.canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' || this.state !== 'playing') return
      lookId = e.pointerId
      lx = e.clientX; ly = e.clientY
    })
    this.canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' || lookId !== e.pointerId || this.state !== 'playing') return
      e.preventDefault()
      this.player.look((e.clientX - lx) * 2.1, (e.clientY - ly) * 2.1, 0.0022)
      lx = e.clientX; ly = e.clientY
    })
    const endLook = (e) => { if (lookId === e.pointerId) lookId = null }
    this.canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', endLook)
    this.canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', endLook)

    const attack = $('#t-attack')
    attack.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation()
      if (this.state !== 'playing') return
      sound.init()
      this.player.startCharge()
    })
    attack.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      this.player.releaseCharge()
    })
    attack.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => this.player.cancelCharge())

    const bindHold = (id, down, up) => {
      const el = $(id)
      el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation()
        if (this.state !== 'playing') return
        el.classList.add('on')
        down()
      })
      const end = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        el.classList.remove('on')
        up && up()
      }
      el.addEventListener('pointerup', end)
      el.addEventListener('pointercancel', end)
    }
    bindHold('#t-block', () => this.player.blockDown(), () => this.player.blockUp())
    bindHold('#t-dodge', () => this.player.dodge())
    bindHold('#t-kick', () => this.player.shove())
    $('#t-exec').addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation()
      this.tryExecute()
    })
  }

  setTouchVisible(on) {
    this.ui.touchControls.classList.toggle('hidden', !(on && this.touch))
  }

  onResize() {
    const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, this.low ? 1 : 1.7))
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h)
    this.camera.aspect = w / h
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
    this.resizeBlood()
    const portrait = h > w * 1.05
    this.ui.rotate.classList.toggle('hidden', !(this.touch && portrait && this.state === 'playing'))
  }

  resizeBlood() {
    const c = this.ui.bloodCanvas
    c.width = window.innerWidth
    c.height = window.innerHeight
    this.bloodCtx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height)
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Flow                                                                */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  startRun(weapon) {
    sound.init()
    sound.resume()
    this.selectedWeapon = weapon
    this.state = 'playing'
    this.paused = false
    this.wave = 0
    this.kills = 0
    this.score = 0
    this.combo = 0
    this.comboTimer = 0
    this.stats = { dismemberments: 0, bestCombo: 0 }
    this.enemies.forEach((e) => this.removeFighter(e))
    this.enemies = []
    this.spawnQueue = []
    this.pickups.forEach((p) => this.removePickup(p))
    this.pickups = []
    this.gore.clear()
    this.bloodCtx.clearRect(0, 0, this.ui.bloodCanvas.width, this.ui.bloodCanvas.height)
    this.hitstop = 0
    this.slowmoTimer = 0
    this.slowmo = 1
    this.waveBreak = 0
    this.waveActive = false
    this.deathTimer = 0
    this.ui.killfeed.innerHTML = ''
    this.ui.floaters.innerHTML = ''
    this.ui.menu.classList.remove('open')
    this.ui.gameover.classList.remove('open')
    this.ui.pause.classList.remove('open')
    this.ui.hud.classList.remove('hidden')
    this.player.reset(weapon)
    this.player.rig.visible = true
    this.setTouchVisible(true)
    this.updateWeaponUI()
    this.updateHealthUI(true)
    this.setBanner('WAVE I', 'LET THE BLOOD FLOW', 'THE RED KING IS WATCHING')
    this.startWave(1)
    this.requestLock()
    this.ui.hint.classList.remove('fade')
    clearTimeout(this._hintTimer)
    this._hintTimer = setTimeout(() => this.ui.hint.classList.add('fade'), 9000)
    this.crowdPulse = 1
    this.arena.excite(2)
  }

  toMenu() {
    this.state = 'menu'
    this.paused = false
    this.enemies.forEach((e) => this.removeFighter(e))
    this.enemies = []
    this.spawnQueue = []
    this.pickups.forEach((p) => this.removePickup(p))
    this.pickups = []
    this.gore.clear()
    this.bloodCtx.clearRect(0, 0, this.ui.bloodCanvas.width, this.ui.bloodCanvas.height)
    this.ui.menu.classList.add('open')
    this.ui.pause.classList.remove('open')
    this.ui.gameover.classList.remove('open')
    this.ui.hud.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.banner.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.killfeed.innerHTML = ''
    this.ui.floaters.innerHTML = ''
    this.setTouchVisible(false)
    this.player.rig.visible = false
    this.player.alive = false
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock()
    this.ui.bestScore.textContent = this.best.score || 0
    this.ui.bestWave.textContent = this.best.wave ? roman(this.best.wave) : '—'
    this.ui.rotate.classList.add('hidden')
    this.clearBloodOverlay(true)
  }

  pause() {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    this.state = 'paused'
    this.paused = true
    this.player.blockUp()
    this.player.cancelCharge()
    this.ui.pause.classList.add('open')
    this.ui.pauseWave.textContent = 'WAVE ' + roman(this.wave)
    this.ui.pauseKills.textContent = this.kills
    this.ui.pauseScore.textContent = this.score
    this.setTouchVisible(false)
    this.ui.rotate.classList.add('hidden')
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock()
    sound.ui()
  }

  resume() {
    if (this.state !== 'paused') return
    this.state = 'playing'
    this.paused = false
    this.ui.pause.classList.remove('open')
    this.setTouchVisible(true)
    this.onResize()
    const portrait = window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth * 1.05
    this.ui.rotate.classList.toggle('hidden', !(this.touch && portrait))
    this.requestLock()
    sound.ui()
  }

  requestLock() {
    if (this.touch) return
    try {
      const p = this.canvas.requestPointerLock?.({ unadjustedMovement: true })
      if (p?.catch) p.catch(() => {
        try { this.canvas.requestPointerLock?.() } catch {}
      })
      this.lockRequested = true
    } catch {
      try { this.canvas.requestPointerLock?.() } catch {}
    }
  }

  gameOver() {
    if (this.state === 'gameover') return
    this.state = 'gameover'
    this.ui.gameover.classList.add('open')
    this.setTouchVisible(false)
    this.ui.rotate.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.goWave.textContent = roman(this.wave)
    this.ui.goKills.textContent = this.kills
    this.ui.goScore.textContent = this.score
    this.ui.goRecord.textContent = ''
    if (this.score > (this.best.score || 0)) {
      this.best.score = this.score
      this.ui.goRecord.textContent = 'A NEW RECORD. THE CROWD WILL REMEMBER YOU.'
    }
    if (this.wave > (this.best.wave || 0)) this.best.wave = this.wave
    if (this.kills > (this.best.kills || 0)) this.best.kills = this.kills
    this.saveBest()
    this.ui.bestScore.textContent = this.best.score
    this.ui.bestWave.textContent = roman(this.best.wave)
    this.ui.hud.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock()
    this.deathLine()
    sound.crowdRoar(1.2, 3)
  }

  deathLine() {
    const lines = [
      'The crowd got what it paid for.',
      'Your blood feeds the sand like all the rest.',
      'The Red King does not remember your name.',
      'Steel is honest. You were not fast enough.',
      'Somewhere, a hammer is still falling.'
    ]
    $('#death-line').textContent = pick(lines)
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Waves                                                               */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  startWave(n) {
    this.wave = n
    this.waveActive = true
    this.waveBreak = 0
    const boss = n % 5 === 0
    const count = boss ? 2 + Math.floor(n / 5) : Math.min(8, 2 + Math.floor((n - 1) * 0.8) + 1)
    this.spawnQueue = []
    const types = []
    if (boss) types.push('executioner')
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let type = 'duelist'
      if (boss && i < 2) type = 'duelist'
      else if (chance(Math.min(0.55, 0.1 + n * 0.055))) type = 'brute'
      types.push(type)
    }
    if (boss) types[0] = 'executioner'
    for (let i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
      this.spawnQueue.push({ type: types[i], delay: i * rand(0.55, 1.1) })
    }
    this.waveEnemyTotal = count
    this.waveKills = 0
    this.ui.enemiesLeft.textContent = `${count} CHALLENGER${count > 1 ? 'S' : ''} REMAIN`
    this.ui.waveNumber.textContent = 'WAVE ' + roman(n)
    const titles = boss
      ? ['THE EXECUTIONER COMES', 'A BIGGER SHADOW', 'THE RED KING SENDS HIS BUTCHER']
      : n === 1
        ? ['LET THE BLOOD FLOW', 'WELCOME TO THE PIT']
        : ['MORE MEAT FOR THE SAND', 'THE CROWD HUNGERS', 'STEEL IS THIRSTY', 'ANOTHER BATCH OF HEROES']
    this.setBanner('WAVE ' + roman(n), pick(titles), boss ? 'SURVIVE' : `${count} CHALLENGERS`)
    if (boss) {
      sound.bossRoar()
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.remove('hidden')
      this.ui.bossName.textContent = 'THE EXECUTIONER'
    } else {
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
    }
    this.arena.excite(1)
    this.ui.rotate.classList.toggle('hidden', !(this.touch && window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth * 1.05))
  }

  checkWaveState(dt) {
    if (!this.waveActive) return
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    const alive = this.enemies.some((e) => !e.dead)
    if (this.spawnQueue.length === 0 && !alive) {
      this.waveActive = false
      this.waveBreak = 4.8
      this.ui.enemiesLeft.textContent = 'THE SAND IS QUIET'
      this.setBanner('WAVE ' + roman(this.wave) + ' CLEARED', 'THE SAND IS QUIET', 'CATCH YOUR BREATH')
      this.player.health = Math.min(this.player.maxHealth, this.player.health + 22)
      this.updateHealthUI()
      this.ui.comboWrap.classList.add('hidden')
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
      sound.crowdRoar(1, 2.4)
      this.arena.excite(1.5)
    }
    if (this.waveBreak > 0) {
      this.waveBreak -= dt
      this.ui.enemiesLeft.textContent = `NEXT WAVE IN ${Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.waveBreak))}`
      if (this.waveBreak <= 0) {
        this.cleanupArena()
        this.startWave(this.wave + 1)
      }
    }
  }

  cleanupArena() {
    // keep the blood, clear the oldest corpses so the pit stays playable
    let dead = this.enemies.filter((e) => e.dead)
    const keep = this.low ? 1 : 3
    for (let i = 0; i < dead.length - keep; i++) this.removeFighter(dead[i])
    this.enemies = this.enemies.filter((e) => !e.removed)
    this.pickups = this.pickups.filter((p) => {
      if (!p.mesh.parent) { this.removePickup(p); return false }
      return true
    })
  }

  spawnEnemy(type, forcedPos) {
    const cfg = ENEMY_TYPES[type]
    let pos
    if (forcedPos) pos = forcedPos.clone()
    else if (this.wave === 1 && this.enemies.length < 3) {
      const side = this.enemies.length === 0 ? -1 : this.enemies.length === 1 ? 1 : 0
      pos = new THREE.Vector3(side * rand(2.5, 5.5), 0, 6.5 - rand(7, 10.5))
      if (this.enemies.length === 2) pos.set(rand(-2, 2), 0, -2.5)
    } else {
      const pts = this.arena.spawnPoints
      const p = pick(pts)
      pos = p.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(rand(-0.8, 0.8), 0, rand(-0.8, 0.8)))
    }
    const enemy = new Fighter(this.scene, this.gore, type, pos, this)
    enemy.id = ++this.enemyId
    enemy.root.position.copy(pos)
    enemy.root.rotation.y = Math.atan2(-pos.x, -pos.z)
    enemy.wave = this.wave
    this.enemies.push(enemy)
    this.gore.blood.burst(new THREE.Vector3(pos.x, 0.15, pos.z), { count: 16, chaos: 1.8, size: 0.7, vy: 1.4 })
    this.arena.excite(0.4)
    if (cfg.boss) {
      this.crowdPulse = 1
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
    sound.crowdRoar(0.5, 1.2)
    return enemy
  }

  removeFighter(f) {
    if (!f || f.removed) return
    f.removed = true
    if (f.root.parent) f.scene.remove(f.root)
    f.hitParts = []
  }

  updateWaves(dt) {
    // spawn from queue
    const maxActive = this.low ? 3 : this.wave >= 4 ? 4 : 3
    const alive = this.enemies.filter((e) => !e.dead).length
    if (this.spawnQueue.length > 0) {
      this.spawnQueue[0].delay -= dt
      if (this.spawnQueue[0].delay <= 0 && alive < maxActive) {
        const item = this.spawnQueue.shift()
        this.spawnEnemy(item.type)
      }
    }
    const remaining = this.spawnQueue.length + this.enemies.filter((e) => !e.dead).length
    this.ui.enemiesLeft.textContent = this.waveBreak > 0
      ? `NEXT WAVE IN ${Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.waveBreak))}`
      : `${remaining} CHALLENGER${remaining === 1 ? '' : 'S'} REMAIN`
    this.checkWaveState(dt)

    // boss bar
    const boss = this.enemies.find((e) => !e.dead && e.cfg.boss)
    if (boss) {
      const hp = clamp(boss.partHp.torso / boss.partMax.torso, 0, 1)
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.remove('hidden')
      this.ui.bossFill.style.width = (hp * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'
    } else if (this.waveBreak <= 0) {
      this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
    }

    // corpse cleanup
    for (const e of this.enemies) {
      if (e.dead && !e.removed) {
        if (e.deathTimer > (this.low ? 12 : 22) && e.root.parent) this.removeFighter(e)
      }
    }
    if (this.enemies.length > 14) {
      this.enemies = this.enemies.filter((e) => !e.removed)
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Input                                                               */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  onKeyDown(e) {
    const code = e.code
    if (code === 'Escape') {
      if (this.state === 'playing') { e.preventDefault(); this.pause() }
      else if (this.state === 'paused') { e.preventDefault(); this.resume() }
      return
    }
    if (code === 'KeyM') { sound.setMuted(!sound.muted); return }
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    if (code === 'KeyW' || code === 'ArrowUp') { this.keys.w = true; e.preventDefault() }
    if (code === 'KeyS' || code === 'ArrowDown') { this.keys.s = true; e.preventDefault() }
    if (code === 'KeyA' || code === 'ArrowLeft') { this.keys.a = true; e.preventDefault() }
    if (code === 'KeyD' || code === 'ArrowRight') { this.keys.d = true; e.preventDefault() }
    if (code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); this.player.shove() }
    if (code === 'ShiftLeft' || code === 'ShiftRight') { e.preventDefault(); this.player.dodge() }
    if (code === 'KeyE') { e.preventDefault(); this.tryInteract() }
    this.updateMoveInput()
  }

  onKeyUp(e) {
    const code = e.code
    if (code === 'KeyW' || code === 'ArrowUp') this.keys.w = false
    if (code === 'KeyS' || code === 'ArrowDown') this.keys.s = false
    if (code === 'KeyA' || code === 'ArrowLeft') this.keys.a = false
    if (code === 'KeyD' || code === 'ArrowRight') this.keys.d = false
    this.updateMoveInput()
  }

  updateMoveInput() {
    if (!this.keys) return
    let x = (this.keys.d ? 1 : 0) - (this.keys.a ? 1 : 0)
    let z = (this.keys.s ? 1 : 0) - (this.keys.w ? 1 : 0)
    const len = Math.hypot(x, z)
    if (len > 1) { x /= len; z /= len }
    this.player.moveInput.x = x
    this.player.moveInput.z = z
  }

  onMouseDown(e) {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    sound.init()
    if (!this.touch && !document.pointerLockElement) {
      this.dragging = true
      this.dragMoved = 0
      this.lastMouse.x = e.clientX
      this.lastMouse.y = e.clientY
      if (e.button === 0) this.requestLock()
    }
    if (e.button === 0) this.player.startCharge()
    if (e.button === 2) { e.preventDefault(); this.player.blockDown() }
  }

  onMouseUp(e) {
    if (e.button === 0) {
      if (this.state === 'playing') this.player.releaseCharge()
      this.dragging = false
    }
    if (e.button === 2) this.player.blockUp()
  }

  onMouseMove(e) {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    if (document.pointerLockElement === this.canvas) {
      this.player.look(e.movementX || 0, e.movementY || 0)
    } else if (this.dragging) {
      const dx = e.clientX - this.lastMouse.x
      const dy = e.clientY - this.lastMouse.y
      this.lastMouse.x = e.clientX
      this.lastMouse.y = e.clientY
      this.dragMoved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy)
      this.player.look(dx * 1.4, dy * 1.4, 0.0022)
    }
  }

  tryInteract() {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    if (this.tryExecute()) return
    this.tryPickup()
  }

  tryExecute() {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return false
    const target = this.findExecutionTarget()
    if (!target) return false
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3(
      target.root.position.x - this.player.pos.x,
      0,
      target.root.position.z - this.player.pos.z
    ).normalize()
    // move the player into range, then cinematic strike
    this.player.executing = 0.72
    this.player.attackState = 'idle'
    this.player.charging = false
    this.player.blocking = false
    this.player.invuln = 1.2
    this.player.rig.position.z -= 0.12
    this.slowmo = 0.28
    this.slowmoTimer = 0.62
    this.hitstop = 0.04
    target.staggerTimer = 0.4
    target.execute(this.player.weaponId === 'hammer' ? 'hammer' : 'sword', dir)
    this.player.shake(0.45)
    this.bloodSplatter(10, 0.85)
    this.ui.exec.classList.add('hidden')
    this.crowdPulse = 1
    this.arena.excite(2.5)
    this.gameOverFlash = Math.max(this.gameOverFlash || 0, 0.35)
    return true
  }

  tryPickup() {
    let best = null, bestD = 2.3
    for (const p of this.pickups) {
      if (!p.mesh.parent) continue
      p.mesh.getWorldPosition(this._v)
      const d = Math.hypot(this._v.x - this.player.pos.x, this._v.z - this.player.pos.z)
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = p }
    }
    if (!best) return false
    if (best.type === this.player.weaponId) {
      // already carrying it, still remove litter swap? keep it
      return false
    }
    this.player.setWeapon(best.type)
    this.removePickup(best)
    this.pickups = this.pickups.filter((p) => p !== best)
    this.addScore(40, null, '+40 GLORY')
    this.addKillFeed('TAKEN', best.type.toUpperCase(), 40)
    return true
  }

  findExecutionTarget() {
    if (!this.player.alive) return null
    let best = null, bestD = 3.4
    const sin = Math.sin(this.player.yaw), cos = Math.cos(this.player.yaw)
    for (const e of this.enemies) {
      if (e.dead) continue
      if (e.staggerTimer <= 0.05) continue
      const dx = e.root.position.x - this.player.pos.x
      const dz = e.root.position.z - this.player.pos.z
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
      if (d > bestD) continue
      const dot = (dx * sin + dz * cos) / (d || 1)
      if (dot < 0.2) continue
      bestD = d
      best = e
    }
    return best
  }

  findPickupTarget() {
    let best = null, bestD = 2.3
    for (const p of this.pickups) {
      if (!p.mesh.parent) continue
      p.mesh.getWorldPosition(this._v)
      const d = Math.hypot(this._v.x - this.player.pos.x, this._v.z - this.player.pos.z)
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = p }
    }
    return best
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Combat callbacks                                                    */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  playerSwing(player, a, b, kind, damage, type, hitRadius, hitSet) {
    const dir = this._v2.copy(b).sub(a)
    if (dir.lengthSq() < 1e-6) dir.set(0, 0, -1)
    dir.normalize()
    const maxEnemies = player.weaponId === 'hammer' ? 3 : 1
    let hits = 0
    for (const enemy of this.enemies) {
      if (enemy.dead) continue
      if (hitSet.has(enemy.id)) continue
      const camDist = Math.hypot(enemy.root.position.x - player.pos.x, enemy.root.position.z - player.pos.z)
      if (camDist > player.attackRange + 1.4) continue
      const hit = enemy.hitTest(a, b, hitRadius)
      if (!hit) continue
      hitSet.add(enemy.id)
      const result = enemy.takeHit(hit.key, damage, type, dir, hit.point, { fromPlayer: true })
      if (result?.blocked) {
        this.onEnemyBlocked(enemy, hit.point)
        sound.metal()
        this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.03)
        this.player.shake(0.08)
        break
      }
      this.gore.impact(hit.point, dir, kind === 'heavy' ? 1.5 : 0.9, 'flesh')
      this.gore.bloodSpray(hit.point, dir, kind === 'heavy' ? 32 : 16, 4.5, 1)
      hitSet.add(enemy.id)
      enemy.checkDestroy(result, dir, hit.point)
      this.onPlayerHit(enemy, hit, result, type, kind, hit.point)
      hits++
      if (hits >= maxEnemies) break
    }
  }

  playerShove(player) {
    const sin = Math.sin(player.yaw), cos = Math.cos(player.yaw)
    let hitAny = false
    for (const enemy of this.enemies) {
      if (enemy.dead) continue
      const dx = enemy.root.position.x - player.pos.x
      const dz = enemy.root.position.z - player.pos.z
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
      if (d > 2.5) continue
      const dot = (dx * sin + dz * cos) / (d || 1)
      if (dot < 0.35) continue
      hitAny = true
      enemy.staggerTimer = Math.max(enemy.staggerTimer, enemy.cfg.boss ? 0.3 : 0.9)
      enemy.state = 'stagger'
      enemy.stateTime = 0
      const p = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.root.position.x, 1.1, enemy.root.position.z)
      this.gore.bloodSpray(p, { x: dx / d, y: 0.2, z: dz / d }, 8, 2.5, 0.6)
      this.addFloater(p, 'SHOVED', 'gold')
      sound.hitFlesh(0.6)
      this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.035)
    }
    if (hitAny) {
      this.player.shake(0.1)
      this.addScore(10, null, null)
    }
  }

  onPlayerHit(enemy, hit, result, type, kind, point) {
    const dmg = Math.round(result?.applied || 0)
    this.player.bloodied = (this.player.bloodied || 0) + 1
    this.bumpCombo(1)
    this.addScore(Math.round((4 + dmg * 0.25) * this.comboMult()), null, null)
    if (dmg >= 10) this.addFloater(point, String(dmg), kind === 'heavy' ? 'big' : '')
    if (this.player.weaponModel?.userData.stain) this.player.weaponModel.userData.stain.visible = true
    sound.hitFlesh(clamp(dmg / 40, 0.5, 1.6))
    if (type === 'crush' && chance(0.5)) sound.hitBone(0.8)
    this.shakeAmount(0.06 + dmg * 0.0015)
    this.showHitmarker(false)
    this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, kind === 'heavy' ? 0.055 : 0.028)
    if (enemy.dead || result?.destroyed) this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.075)
    if (kind === 'heavy') this.bloodSplatter(2, 0.35)
    this.player.comboTimer = 0.5
  }

  onEnemyBlocked(enemy, point) {
    this.addFloater(point, 'BLOCKED', 'gold')
    this.showHitmarker(false)
    this.addScore(5, null, null)
  }

  onDismember(enemy, label, pos, kind) {
    this.stats.dismemberments++
    const bonusMap = {
      ARM: 140, 'LEFT ARM': 140, LEG: 120, 'LEFT LEG': 120, HEAD: 320,
      'SKULL CRUSHED': 260, BISECTED: 500, 'CHEST CAVED IN': 420,
      'RIB CAGE SHATTERED': 420, EXECUTION: 380, DECAPITATION: 340,
      'CUT IN HALF': 500
    }
    const base = (bonusMap[label] || 150)
    this.bumpCombo(2)
    this.addScore(base, pos, `+${base} GLORY`)
    this.addKillFeed(enemy.cfg.name, label, base)
    this.stats.bestCombo = Math.max(this.stats.bestCombo, this.combo)
    this.crowdPulse = 1
    this.arena.excite(kind === 'bisect' ? 2.4 : 1.4)
    if (kind === 'decap' || kind === 'crush' || kind === 'bisect' || kind === 'execute') {
      this.slowmo = 0.32
      this.slowmoTimer = Math.max(this.slowmoTimer, kind === 'bisect' ? 0.55 : 0.3)
      this.bloodSplatter(kind === 'bisect' ? 12 : 8, 0.75)
    } else {
      this.bloodSplatter(3, 0.4)
    }
    sound.sever()
    this.gameOverFlash = 0.3
  }

  onKill(enemy, label, pos, executed = false) {
    this.kills++
    this.waveKills = (this.waveKills || 0) + 1
    this.bumpCombo(2)
    const base = 90 + this.wave * 12 + (executed ? 80 : 0)
    this.addScore(base, pos, `+${base}`)
    this.ui.kills.textContent = `${this.kills} KILL${this.kills === 1 ? '' : 'S'}`
    this.addKillFeed(enemy.cfg.name, label, base)
    this.crowdPulse = 1
    this.arena.excite(1.6)
    this.bloodSplatter(5, 0.55)
    this.showHitmarker(true)
    this.gameOverFlash = 0.25
  }

  onWeaponDrop(type, mesh) {
    if (!mesh || mesh.userData.isPickup) return
    mesh.userData.isPickup = true
    const marker = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
      map: softDropTexture(), color: type === 'hammer' ? 0xffcf7a : 0x9fd4ff,
      transparent: true, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, opacity: 0.9
    }))
    marker.scale.set(0.7, 0.7, 1)
    marker.position.set(0, 0.5, 0)
    mesh.add(marker)
    this.pickups.push({ type, mesh, marker, id: Math.random() })
    // clean up old pickups
    if (this.pickups.length > 4) {
      const old = this.pickups.shift()
      this.removePickup(old)
    }
  }

  removePickup(p) {
    if (!p) return
    if (p.marker?.parent) p.marker.parent.remove(p.marker)
    if (p.mesh?.parent) p.mesh.parent.remove(p.mesh)
  }

  onPlayerHurt(dmg, attacker, dir) {
    this.ui.damageFlash.style.opacity = clamp(0.25 + dmg / 55, 0, 0.9)
    setTimeout(() => { this.ui.damageFlash.style.opacity = 0 }, 130)
    this.bloodSplatter(Math.min(14, 4 + dmg * 0.35), 0.7)
    this.player.shake(0.25)
    this.shakeAmount(0.2)
    this.updateHealthUI()
    if (this.player.health < 32) {
      this.lastHeartbeat = 0
    }
  }

  onParry(attacker) {
    attacker.staggerTimer = Math.max(attacker.staggerTimer, 1.25)
    attacker.state = 'stagger'
    attacker.stateTime = 0
    this.addScore(60, attacker.root.position, '+60 PARRY')
    this.addFloater(new THREE.Vector3(attacker.root.position.x, 1.8, attacker.root.position.z), 'PARRY', 'gold')
    this.bumpCombo(1)
    this.arena.excite(1)
    this.showHitmarker(true)
    this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.04)
  }

  onPlayerDeath(attacker) {
    this.state = 'dying'
    this.deathTimer = 0
    this.player.rig.visible = false
    this.bloodSplatter(30, 1)
    this.ui.damageFlash.style.opacity = 0.95
    setTimeout(() => { this.ui.damageFlash.style.opacity = 0 }, 500)
    this.ui.bossWrap.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.exec.classList.add('hidden')
    this.ui.interact.classList.add('hidden')
    this.slowmo = 0.25
    this.slowmoTimer = 1.4
    this.setTouchVisible(false)
  }

  onWeaponChanged(type) {
    this.updateWeaponUI()
    this.player.weaponModel.userData.stain.visible = (this.player.bloodied || 0) > 0
  }

  updateWeaponUI() {
    const w = this.player.stats
    this.ui.weaponName.textContent = w.name
    this.ui.weaponKind.textContent = w.kind
    this.ui.weaponIcon.className = 'weapon-icon ' + this.player.weaponId + ' swap'
    setTimeout(() => { this.ui.weaponIcon.className = 'weapon-icon ' + this.player.weaponId }, 420)
    this.selectedWeapon = this.player.weaponId
  }

  enemyHitPlayer(enemy, amount, weaponKind) {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3(
      this.player.pos.x - enemy.root.position.x,
      0,
      this.player.pos.z - enemy.root.position.z
    ).normalize()
    const result = this.player.takeDamage(amount, enemy, weaponKind, dir)
    if (result?.blocked && !result.parried) {
      this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.025)
      this.player.shake(0.18)
      this.showHitmarker(false)
    }
    if (result?.parried) {
      this.hitstop = Math.max(this.hitstop, 0.06)
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Scoring / feedback                                                  */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  bumpCombo(n = 1) {
    this.combo += n
    this.comboTimer = this.comboMaxTime
    this.ui.comboWrap.classList.remove('hidden')
    this.ui.comboMult.textContent = 'x' + this.comboMult().toFixed(1).replace('.0', '')
    this.stats.bestCombo = Math.max(this.stats.bestCombo, this.combo)
    this.ui.comboWrap.style.animation = 'none'
    void this.ui.comboWrap.offsetWidth
    this.ui.comboWrap.style.animation = ''
  }

  comboMult() {
    return 1 + Math.min(4, Math.floor(this.combo / 4) * 0.5)
  }

  addScore(amount, pos, floaterText) {
    const gain = Math.round(amount * (amount > 20 ? this.comboMult() : 1))
    this.score += gain
    this.ui.score.textContent = this.score
    if (pos && floaterText) this.addFloater(pos, floaterText, 'gold')
  }

  addFloater(worldPos, text, cls = '') {
    if (!worldPos) return
    const v = this._v.copy(worldPos).project(this.camera)
    if (v.z > 1 || v.z < -1) return
    const x = (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * window.innerWidth
    const y = (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * window.innerHeight
    if (x < -100 || x > window.innerWidth + 100 || y < -100 || y > window.innerHeight + 100) return
    const el = document.createElement('div')
    el.className = 'floater ' + cls
    el.textContent = text
    el.style.left = x + 'px'
    el.style.top = y + 'px'
    this.ui.floaters.appendChild(el)
    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 1000)
    if (this.ui.floaters.childElementCount > 24) this.ui.floaters.firstChild?.remove()
  }

  addKillFeed(actor, action, points) {
    const row = document.createElement('div')
    row.className = 'kf-row'
    row.innerHTML = `${actor} <b>${action}</b> <i>+${points}</i>`
    this.ui.killfeed.prepend(row)
    while (this.ui.killfeed.childElementCount > 5) this.ui.killfeed.lastChild.remove()
    setTimeout(() => {
      row.style.transition = 'opacity .5s'
      row.style.opacity = '0'
      setTimeout(() => row.remove(), 600)
    }, 5200)
  }

  showHitmarker(kill) {
    const hm = this.ui.hitmarker
    hm.classList.remove('show', 'kill')
    void hm.offsetWidth
    hm.classList.toggle('kill', !!kill)
    hm.classList.add('show')
  }

  shakeAmount(v) {
    this.player.shake(v)
  }

  setBanner(kicker, title, sub, red = false) {
    this.ui.bannerKicker.textContent = kicker
    this.ui.bannerTitle.textContent = title
    this.ui.bannerSub.textContent = sub
    this.ui.bannerTitle.classList.toggle('red', red)
    this.ui.banner.classList.remove('hidden', 'out')
    void this.ui.banner.offsetWidth
    this.ui.banner.style.animation = ''
    clearTimeout(this._bannerTimer)
    this._bannerTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.ui.banner.classList.add('out')
      setTimeout(() => this.ui.banner.classList.add('hidden'), 400)
    }, 2600)
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Screen blood                                                        */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  bloodSplatter(strength = 5, alphaScale = 0.7) {
    const ctx = this.bloodCtx
    if (!ctx) return
    const w = this.ui.bloodCanvas.width, h = this.ui.bloodCanvas.height
    const n = Math.min(16, Math.floor(strength))
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const edge = chance(0.7)
      const x = edge
        ? (chance(0.5) ? rand(0, w * 0.26) : rand(w * 0.74, w))
        : rand(w * 0.2, w * 0.8)
      const y = edge ? rand(0, h) : rand(0, h * 0.55)
      const r = rand(6, 44) * (0.6 + strength * 0.05)
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r)
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(118,2,8,${rand(0.5, 0.85) * alphaScale})`)
      g.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(88,2,7,${rand(0.3, 0.55) * alphaScale})`)
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,0,4,0)')
      ctx.fillStyle = g
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
      // droplets
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        const a = rand(0, TAU), d = rand(r * 0.5, r * 2.2)
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${80 + randInt(0, 40)},2,6,${rand(0.25, 0.6) * alphaScale})`
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.ellipse(x + Math.cos(a) * d, y + Math.sin(a) * d, rand(1, 5), rand(1, 9), a, 0, TAU)
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }
  }

  clearBloodOverlay() {
    this.bloodCtx.clearRect(0, 0, this.ui.bloodCanvas.width, this.ui.bloodCanvas.height)
  }

  updateBloodFade(raw) {
    // gradual fade of old gore from the lens
    if (this._bloodFadeAcc === undefined) this._bloodFadeAcc = 0
    this._bloodFadeAcc += raw
    if (this._bloodFadeAcc < 0.12) return
    this._bloodFadeAcc = 0
    const ctx = this.bloodCtx
    const w = this.ui.bloodCanvas.width, h = this.ui.bloodCanvas.height
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.035)'
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* HUD                                                                 */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  updateHealthUI(instant = false) {
    const pct = clamp(this.player.health / this.player.maxHealth, 0, 1)
    this.ui.healthFill.style.transform = `scaleX(${pct})`
    this.ui.healthLag.style.transform = `scaleX(${pct})`
    this.ui.healthFill.classList.toggle('low', pct < 0.3)
    if (instant) this.ui.healthLag.style.transition = 'none'
    else this.ui.healthLag.style.transition = ''
  }

  updateHUD(dt) {
    // health lags smooth
    this.updateHealthUI()

    // charge ring
    if (this.player.charging && this.player.alive) {
      const t = clamp(this.player.chargeTime / 1.0, 0, 1)
      this.ui.chargeRing.style.opacity = '1'
      this.ui.ringFill.style.strokeDashoffset = String(264 * (1 - t))
      this.ui.ringFill.style.stroke = t >= 0.26 ? '#ff2f2f' : 'rgba(255,80,60,.7)'
    } else {
      this.ui.chargeRing.style.opacity = '0'
    }

    // combo timer
    if (this.comboTimer > 0) {
      this.comboTimer -= dt
      this.ui.comboWrap.classList.remove('hidden')
      this.ui.comboTimer.style.transform = `scaleX(${clamp(this.comboTimer / this.comboMaxTime, 0, 1)})`
      if (this.comboTimer <= 0) {
        this.ui.comboWrap.classList.add('hidden')
        this.combo = 0
      }
    }

    // aim target
    let hot = false
    let execTarget = null
    const sin = Math.sin(this.player.yaw), cos = Math.cos(this.player.yaw)
    for (const e of this.enemies) {
      if (e.dead) continue
      const dx = e.root.position.x - this.player.pos.x
      const dz = e.root.position.z - this.player.pos.z
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
      if (d > 3.8) continue
      const dot = (dx * sin + dz * cos) / (d || 1)
      if (dot > 0.965) { hot = true }
      if (e.staggerTimer > 0.05 && d < 3.4 && dot > 0.2) execTarget = e
    }
    this.ui.crosshair.classList.toggle('hot', hot)
    this.ui.exec.classList.toggle('hidden', !execTarget || this.state !== 'playing')
    if (this.touch) {
      $('#t-exec').classList.toggle('hidden', !execTarget)
    }

    const pickup = this.findPickupTarget()
    if (pickup && !execTarget) {
      this.ui.interact.classList.remove('hidden')
      this.ui.interactText.textContent = 'TAKE THE ' + pickup.type.toUpperCase()
    } else {
      this.ui.interact.classList.add('hidden')
    }

    // low health heartbeat
    if (this.player.alive && this.player.health < 32) {
      this.lastHeartbeat -= dt
      if (this.lastHeartbeat <= 0) {
        this.lastHeartbeat = 1.15
        sound.heartbeat(1 - this.player.health / 40)
      }
    }

    // banner rotate note
    if (this.touch && this.state === 'playing') {
      this.ui.rotate.classList.toggle('hidden', !(window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth * 1.05))
    }

    // pickups marker bob
    for (const p of this.pickups) {
      if (!p.marker.parent) continue
      p.marker.position.y = 0.5 + Math.sin(this.time * 2.5 + p.id * 10) * 0.12
      p.marker.material.opacity = 0.55 + Math.sin(this.time * 3 + p.id) * 0.25
    }

    // damage flash pulse from hurt
    const hurt = this.player.hurtFlash
    if (hurt > 0.01) {
      this.ui.damageFlash.style.opacity = String(clamp(hurt * 0.8, 0, 0.85))
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Loop                                                                */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

  loop() {
    requestAnimationFrame(this.loop)
    const raw = Math.min(this.clock.getDelta(), 0.05)
    this.time += raw

    if (this.state === 'menu') {
      this.menuAngle += raw * 0.07
      const r = 13.5
      this.camera.position.set(Math.cos(this.menuAngle) * r, 6.6 + Math.sin(this.time * 0.2) * 0.2, Math.sin(this.menuAngle) * r)
      this.camera.lookAt(0, 1.7, 0)
      this.player.rig.visible = false
      this.arena.update(raw, this.time)
      this.gore.update(raw)
      this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
      return
    }

    if (this.state === 'paused') {
      this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
      return
    }

    if (this.state === 'gameover') {
      this.arena.update(raw * 0.3, this.time)
      this.gore.update(raw * 0.3)
      this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
      return
    }

    // time scaling: hit stop, slow-mo, dying
    let dt = raw
    if (this.hitstop > 0) {
      this.hitstop -= raw
      dt = raw * 0.08
    }
    if (this.slowmoTimer > 0) {
      this.slowmoTimer -= raw
      dt = Math.min(dt, raw * this.slowmo)
      if (this.slowmoTimer <= 0) this.slowmo = 1
    }
    if (this.state === 'dying') dt = raw * 0.35

    this.arena.update(raw, this.time)
    this.gore.update(dt)
    this.player.update(dt)

    if (this.state === 'dying') {
      this.deathTimer += raw
      if (this.deathTimer > 1.7) this.gameOver()
    }

    if (this.state === 'playing' || this.state === 'dying') {
      const others = this.enemies
      for (const e of this.enemies) {
        if (e.removed) continue
        if (this.state === 'dying' || !this.player.alive) {
          if (e.dead) e.update(dt, this.time, this.player, others)
          else {
            // enemies circle the corpse
            e.update(dt * 0.45, this.time, this.player, others)
          }
        } else {
          e.update(dt, this.time, this.player, others)
        }
      }
      if (this.state === 'playing') this.updateWaves(dt)
      this.updateHUD(dt)
      this.updateBloodFade(raw)
      this.gore.pools.update(dt)
    }

    this.updateCrowd(raw)
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
  }

  updateCrowd(raw) {
    if (this.crowdPulse > 0) {
      this.crowdPulse = Math.max(0, this.crowdPulse - raw * 0.5)
    }
    // slight camera-driven crowd energy already handled in arena
    if (this.state === 'playing') {
      const h = this.player.health / this.player.maxHealth
      if (h < 0.3 && Math.random() < 0.01) this.arena.excite(0.2)
    }
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Debug surface for automated checks                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const game = new Bloodpit()
  window.__BLOODPIT = game
  window.__bloodpit = {
    game,
    start: (weapon) => game.startRun(weapon || 'sword'),
    spawn: (type = 'duelist', dist = 2.4) => {
      const p = game.player
      const x = p.pos.x + Math.sin(p.yaw) * dist * -1
      const z = p.pos.z + Math.cos(p.yaw) * dist * -1
      return game.spawnEnemy(type, new THREE.Vector3(x, 0, z))
    },
    attack: (heavy = false) => {
      game.player.beginAttack(heavy ? 'heavy' : 'light', heavy ? 1.2 : 0)
    },
    hit: (type = 'head', dmg = 999) => {
      const e = game.enemies.find((x) => !x.dead)
      if (!e) return null
      const dir = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1)
      const point = e.head.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3())
      e.root.updateWorldMatrix(true, true)
      if (type === 'head') {
        const r = e.takeHit('head', dmg, 'slash', dir, point, { fromPlayer: true })
        e.checkDestroy(r, dir, point)
        return r
      }
    },
    screenshotPose: () => {
      // place the camera in front of a freshly mutilated enemy for visual checks
    }
  }
})

## Objective
- Build the user's requested browser game: a first-person gory arena fighter where you spawn with a sword or hammer, fight gladiators in an arena, and can dismember, decapitate, crush skulls/bodies/arms, and bisect enemies with blood/gore.

## Requirements
- "A gory game with alot of blood and gore where you fight people in a arena with swords and hammers you spawn with a sword or a hammer with the hammer you can crush there head and body and arms with the sword you can cut of there limbs and cut him in half"
- Game must be playable in browser, responsive for desktop and mobile/touch, with visible gameplay/controls.

## Decisions
- Built with Vite 8.3.5 + Three.js 0.187.0, vanilla JS modules, fully procedural visuals/audio (no external assets).

## Objective
- Build the user's requested browser game: a first-person gory arena fighter where you spawn with a sword or hammer, fight gladiators in an arena, and can dismember, decapitate, crush skulls/bodies/arms, and bisect enemies with blood/gore.

## Requirements
- "A gory game with alot of blood and gore where you fight people in a arena with swords and hammers you spawn with a sword or a hammer with the hammer you can crush there head and body and arms with the sword you can cut of there limbs and cut him in half"
- Game must be playable in browser, responsive for desktop and mobile/touch, with visible gameplay/controls.

## Decisions
- Built with Vite 8.3.5 + Three.js 0.187.0, vanilla JS modules, fully procedural visuals/audio (no external assets).
- First-person melee arena with wave survival, combo scoring, boss every 5th wave, weapon pickup swapping.
- Sword = slashing/sever/bisect; hammer = crushing/shattering/exploding heads and chest cavities.
- Custom procedural gladiator rigs and custom physics for severed limbs/debris; blood particles, ground decals, pools, fountains, screen blood.
- Auto-detect SwiftShader/software renderer → low-quality mode (no shadows, fewer crowd/particles).
- Static arena geometry batched by material with `mergeGeometries` to reduce draw calls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffold, menu/HUD/pause/gameover/touch UI, full responsive styling, procedural audio/arena/gore/fighter/player systems.
- Gameplay loop verified: wave starts/clears, wave countdown advances, scoring/combo/kill feed, boss spawn/health bar, pause/resume, player death/gameover/retry.
- Gore verified live: sword head decapitation, arm sever, leg sever, bisect; hammer head explosion, chest burst with hidden torso/red cavity/ribs, crushed-limb effects.
- Fixed missing `onFloater` callbacks in `fighter.js` (changed to `addFloater`), eliminating runtime exceptions.
- Fixed broken forward-facing dot products in execution targeting, shove, and HUD “hot” crosshair; execution and shove now work.
- Fixed block/parry facing calculation in `player.js`; blocking front attacks now works and parry zeroes damage.
- Reworked `playerSwing` in `main.js` to use camera-forward arc + aim ray/fallback chest hit test, so melee reliably connects and can target limbs.
- Added favicon data URI, eliminating favicon 404 console error.
- Added static-arena batching in `arena.js`; draw calls reduced significantly (menu ~47 vs ~106).
- Added mobile CSS `padding-right: 42px` to `body.touch #wave-block` to stop pause button overlap.
- Verified mobile portrait/landscape layout, touch STRIKE, execution prompts, weapon pickup, and viewport resizing.
- Production build succeeds; built app verified at `http://localhost:3003` via `vite preview`, 0 console errors.
- Dev server still running on `http://localhost:3002`; preview server running on `http://localhost:3003`.
- Screenshots captured in `screenshots/` for menu, gameplay, gore variants, boss, pause, gameover, pickups, mobile portrait/landscape, and production.

### Active
- Final visual polish/verification after latest batch/CSS changes; mobile portrait screenshot shows pause button now separated from wave text, but check final desktop after HMR.
- Consider whether first-person sword/hammer remains oversized; currently sword scale `0.68`, rig at `(0.44,-0.5,-0.8)`.
- Need final review of all screenshots and possibly capture a fresh final desktop gameplay shot after latest changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture fresh final desktop and mobile screenshots after latest CSS/batching changes; inspect lighting, weapon scale, and UI.
2. Run one final natural wave/gore sanity pass and check browser console for 0 errors.
3. Re-run `npm run build`, confirm `./start.sh` still works, and leave or clean up dev/preview sessions.
4. Commit changes if desired (working tree remains uncommitted).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, waves, scoring, UI wiring, combat hit detection, debug API (`window.__bloodpit`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: first-person controls, weapon rig/poses, blocking/parry, combat, camera.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/fighter.js`: enemy rigs, AI, hit parts, sever/decapitate/bisect/chest-burst/execution logic.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/gore.js`: blood particles, decals, pools, gibs, bisect/head-explosion effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arena.js`: arena environment, lighting, crowd, torches, and static geometry batching.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: all UI styling/responsive/touch layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: UI structure/menu/HUD/touch controls/favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: procedural textures/math helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json`: scripts/dependencies.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: verification screenshots.
- `/tmp/opencode/bloodpit-dev.log`: Vite dev server log.

## Important Context
- Dev server: tmux session `bloodpit`, `npm run dev` on port 3002; preview server in tmux session `preview` on port 3003.
- Playwright CLI sessions: `dev` (desktop), `mobile` (iPhone 15 emulation), `prod` (built site on 3003).
- Use `#play-btn` for Play, not `text=Play`, because hidden “Play Again” also matches.
- Debug API:
  - `window.__bloodpit.start('sword'|'hammer')`
  - `window.__bloodpit.spawn('duelist'|'brute'|'executioner', distance)`
  - `window.__bloodpit.attack(heavyBoolean)`
  - `window.__bloodpit.hit('head', damage)`
  - World access via `window.__BLOODPIT` (game object).
- Controlled combat tests should clear `spawnQueue`/enemies and set high player health; otherwise wave enemies kill the player during automation.
- `window.__BLOODPIT.low` is true under SwiftShader; manual `renderer.render` measured ~5.7 ms while rAF in the harness is throttled (~4–7 fps), so actual browser hardware should be much faster.
